findings: Disabling the prefetch removed it completely (ah=0) but the read time barely moved: 684051 ms against 684320 ms.
Read volume keeps climbing: 5.3 M block reads in 900 s is about 21 GB at 4 KiB, all at 128 us each.
The Data volume is nearly full: 13907 free blocks of 131072, about 54 MiB, so the persistent store is running out of room.
The LaunchServices wait came back, so the v54 observation of waits=0 was a transient state rather than a milestone.
conclusion: driver-level read-ahead and prefetch are both dead ends here; the remaining costs are the per-4KiB command price and the capacity of the Data volume
